name: cf-spend-guard
description: Spend monitoring, anomaly detection and an optional kill switch for Cloudflare accounts. Runs as a Worker in your own account.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token the guard uses to read analytics (and, if you turn on the kill switch, to pause Workers). Create one at [dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) with **Account › Account Analytics › Read**. For the kill switch also add **Account › Workers Scripts › Edit**, **Zone › Workers Routes › Edit** and **Zone › Zone › Read**.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: A long random string that protects the guard's `/api/*` endpoints (status, pause, restore). Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. A Slack [incoming webhook](https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks) URL for alerts. Leave empty to skip.

DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. A Discord channel webhook URL for alerts. Leave empty to skip.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. Any URL that accepts a JSON `POST` of each alert (n8n, Zapier, your own endpoint). Leave empty to skip.

PAGERDUTY_ROUTING_KEY.description: Optional. A PagerDuty Events API v2 routing key. Only `critical` alerts (rule breaches and kill-switch actions) page. Leave empty to skip.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional. The account to watch. If the API token can see exactly one account it is detected automatically.
